evals.prompt: Review the landing page in examples/bad-landing.html for usability problems. We're getting lots of traffic but almost nobody starts a trial.
evals.expected_output: Runs measure.mjs on the file, reports blockers for tiny header icons (Fitts), overlay covering the form and blocking the Send button (Flow/Selective Attention), competing primary CTAs (Von Restorff), placeholder-only and mis-grouped labels (Working Memory, Proximity), horizontal overflow on mobile, and slow Send interaction (Doherty). Each finding has location, evidence and a code fix. Does not flag the 12-item nav under Miller's Law.

evals.prompt: quick ux check on examples/good-landing.html before I merge
evals.expected_output: Check mode table, nearly all pass, at most the minor 24px checkbox row note, verdict 'ship'. Short.
